newsitem.title: USA: Archconservative Jesse Helms wins - CNN.
newsitem.headline: Archconservative Jesse Helms wins - CNN.

text.p: Arch-conservative Jesse Helms, scourge of pornography in the arts and a thorn in the side of the foreign policy establishment, won a fifth U.S. Senate term from North Carolina, according to CNN projections on Tuesday.

The race against black businessman Harvey Gantt, a former mayor of Charlotte, was a rematch of their racially charged contest of six years ago. As chairman of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, Helms, 75, has dueled repeatedly with the Clinton administration. He is co-author of a controverisal law tightening economic sanctions against Cuba.
